description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface. It is used to display log data received from log nodes, formatting log messages with priorities, tags, messages, and exceptions, and appending them to the view while maintaining a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages, implementing the LogNode interface to format and output log data, and stacking log nodes for chain logging.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for creating LogView instances with various attribute options.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the LogView, also passing the log to the next node if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null, with a specified delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
